title: Libree
tagline: DAO treasury as Credit Delegator in AAVE and Liquidity Provider in Uniswap
description:
One of the main inefficiencies of DeFi DAO are “Idle Treasuries” which are unproductive.

Libree project wants to enables DAOs to become more capital efficient through 2 different plugins built on Aragon OSx:

1) Allows DAOs to deposit their treasury in AAVE and to offer credit delegation to other DAOs
2) Provide liquidity to UniSwap

This allows DAOs to approve decisions jointly and to automate them as DeFi strategies
how_its_made: We built 2 plugins on Aragon OSx, created them using solidity, and deployed them in the Mumbai testnet network, in the Aragon repository. The front end is an Aragon app fork, where we have created new features to allow attaching actions to the proposals that will be executed automatically when the proposal passes.
